town_description: Daporijo is the headquarters of Upper Subansiri district, on the banks of the Subansiri river — the largest tributary of the Brahmaputra. The area's best-known religious site is the Meghna cave temple of Shiva nearby; the town itself is a remote district hub reached by long mountain roads.
